name: consistent-module-names
goal: Names match recorded code symbols across cards, relations and detail pages; each module type has documented generator and audit naming rules.

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Prior card override exposed a prose resolver mismatch. Specification and source attribution recorded; canonical symbols and type naming are required.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Extended existing name/catalog, responsive current/history, audit, guide, template and CLI scenarios. Coverage now compares code identity across cards, links and headings.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Test-only b7145c1185aa867064261b13cf83efabfc936632; record 7ea7cf43202684a770b144d801a905311e14a729a9cef18e9e664ac1fc81981d. Registered test titles remain stable; all test inputs match the passing fix.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Use one canonical resolver for cards and relations; centralize type naming in existing rules and expose it to guides, audit and generated instructions.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: One canonical name resolver now serves cards and relations. Existing rule catalog drives naming guidance and generated instructions; owner-local role classes are audited. Structural and focused checks pass.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Final source 57c677244000ec8f9db9c296b79a28dda5b9c397 passes unchanged tests from b7145c1185aa867064261b13cf83efabfc936632. Records: red 7ea7cf43202684a770b144d801a905311e14a729a9cef18e9e664ac1fc81981d; green 2775269924df5854b1c4fb3514fdab7022784a829ca9c0669f2be58e2e6e6177.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: Isolated fixture rejects reintroduced original namer and owner audit with real assertion failures. Restored suites pass; guarded source/test files are byte-identical to final 57c67724.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
steps.evidence: Focused red/green, isolated prevention guard, final build, structure audits and real browser proof pass. Required broad verification retains existing ownership drift, Desktop type/unit failures and two obsolete browser cases; keep verification pending.
